name: MonarchSecurityAlertCard
title: SecurityAlertCard
wrapsNative: MonarchCard with a androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column of alert rows, MonarchBadge, MonarchButton actions, android.text.format.DateUtils.getRelativeTimeSpanString, MonarchEmptyState and MonarchErrorState
summary: Recent security alerts for an account, each with a severity badge, a relative time, an unread mark and optional follow-up, mark-as-read and dismiss actions, plus loading, empty and error states.
whenToUse: On a security or account screen, to list recent sign-ins, password changes and other account events that need the person's attention.
whenNotToUse: For one urgent problem on a screen use MonarchCalloutBanner. For the full account activity use a screen of its own with a LazyColumn of rows.
api: @Composable fun MonarchSecurityAlertCard(alerts: List<MonarchSecurityAlert>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, state: MonarchSecurityAlertCardState = MonarchSecurityAlertCardState.Ready, retrying: Boolean = false, now: Long? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onAction: ((MonarchSecurityAlert) -> Unit)? = null, onMarkRead: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, onMarkAllRead: (() -> Unit)? = null, onDismiss: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, severityIcon: (@Composable (MonarchSecurityAlertSeverity) -> Unit)? = null, dismissIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchSecurityAlertCardLabels = MonarchSecurityAlertCardLabels())

data class MonarchSecurityAlert(id: String, title: String, description: String? = null, severity: MonarchSecurityAlertSeverity = MonarchSecurityAlertSeverity.Info, dateMillis: Long? = null, read: Boolean = false, actionLabel: String? = null)
enum class MonarchSecurityAlertSeverity { Info, Low, Medium, High, Critical }
enum class MonarchSecurityAlertCardState { Ready, Loading, Failed }

class MonarchSecurityAlertCardLabels(title: String? = null, description: String? = null, listLabel: String? = null, severity: ((MonarchSecurityAlertSeverity) -> String)? = null, unread: String? = null, unreadCount: ((Int) -> String)? = null, markRead: String? = null, markAllRead: String? = null, dismissTitle: String? = null, dismiss: ((title: String) -> String)? = null, dismissed: ((title: String) -> String)? = null, loading: String? = null, emptyTitle: String? = null, emptyDescription: String? = null, errorTitle: String? = null)

options.name: state
options.description: Ready, Loading or Failed. A ready, empty list shows the empty state.

options.name: retrying
options.description: Whether a retry is in progress, in the failed state.

options.name: now
options.description: The reference time for relative times, in epoch milliseconds. Without it they follow the clock and update every minute.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Retries loading; shows "Try again" in the failed state.

options.name: onAction
options.description: Runs the follow-up of an alert that has an actionLabel, for example opening the session list.

options.name: onMarkRead
options.description: Marks one alert read. Shows "Mark as read" on unread alerts.

options.name: onMarkAllRead
options.description: Marks every alert read. Shows "Mark all as read" while any are unread.

options.name: onDismiss
options.description: Dismisses an alert; remove it from alerts. Shows a dismiss button on every alert.

options.name: severityIcon
options.description: An icon before each alert, tinted with the severity's strong color and hidden from TalkBack. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: dismissIcon
options.description: The close mark of the dismiss buttons. Without it they show "Dismiss" as text.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string, including the title and the line under it.

states.name: unread
states.description: Bold title, a dot in the accent solid color, an unread count badge in the header, and "Unread" read by TalkBack.

states.name: failed
states.description: A small MonarchErrorState with a retry when onRetry is given; retrying shows its progress.

appearance: A MonarchCard. Severity badges use the tone of the severity (info, neutral for low, warning for medium, danger for high) and critical is drawn solid; severity icons use the strong role of the tone, muted text for low. The unread mark uses the accent solid role. All colors are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web takes a ReactNode description, a heading level and a header link; on Android the title and description are strings in labels and the title has the heading semantics. The web and iOS open an action URL; Monarch for Android components do not navigate, so a follow-up is an actionLabel with onAction, where the app opens its screen or calls LocalUriHandler. Dates are epoch milliseconds. The web moves keyboard focus and iOS moves VoiceOver focus after a dismissal; on Android focus is left to the system and the dismissal is announced. The web's accent tone for the unread mark is drawn with the accent role directly, because MonarchTone has no accent tone. Severity icons are a slot because Monarch bundles no icons; the severity is always written in the badge.
accessibility: The card title is a heading.
Each alert's text is one TalkBack element: the title and description, with the state "Unread", the severity name and the time, so severity and unread state never depend on color or an icon.
Follow-up, mark-as-read and dismiss are separate buttons with 48dp touch targets.
Each dismiss button is named "Dismiss" and the alert title.
After a dismissal "Dismissed" and the title are announced through a polite live region.
Loading, empty and error states are read by MonarchProgress, MonarchEmptyState and MonarchErrorState.
edgeCases: Long titles and descriptions wrap; the badge and time wrap onto a new row at large font sizes.
An alert with an actionLabel and no onAction shows no follow-up.
An alert without a date shows no time.
Unread alerts only show "Mark as read" when onMarkRead is given.

examples.title: Mark read and dismiss
examples.template:
MonarchSecurityAlertCard(
    alerts = alerts,
    onAction = { /* open the session list */ },
    onMarkRead = { id -> alerts = alerts.map { if (it.id == id) it.copy(read = true) else it } },
    onMarkAllRead = { alerts = alerts.map { it.copy(read = true) } },
    onDismiss = { id -> alerts = alerts.filterNot { it.id == id } },
)
examples.setupTemplate:
var alerts by remember {
    mutableStateOf(
        listOf(
            MonarchSecurityAlert(
                id = {{alerts.0.id}},
                title = {{alerts.0.title}},
                description = {{alerts.0.description}},
                severity = MonarchSecurityAlertSeverity.{{alerts.0.severity|pascal}},
                dateMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - {{alerts.0.hoursAgo}} * 3_600_000L,
                actionLabel = {{alerts.0.action}},
            ),
            MonarchSecurityAlert(
                id = {{alerts.1.id}},
                title = {{alerts.1.title}},
                severity = MonarchSecurityAlertSeverity.{{alerts.1.severity|pascal}},
                dateMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - {{alerts.1.hoursAgo}} * 3_600_000L,
            ),
            MonarchSecurityAlert(
                id = {{alerts.2.id}},
                title = {{alerts.2.title}},
                severity = MonarchSecurityAlertSeverity.{{alerts.2.severity|pascal}},
                dateMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - {{alerts.2.hoursAgo}} * 3_600_000L,
                read = {{alerts.2.read}},
            ),
        ),
    )
}
examples.setup:
var alerts by remember {
    mutableStateOf(
        listOf(
            MonarchSecurityAlert(
                id = "a-1",
                title = "New sign-in from Firefox on Linux",
                description = "Lisbon, Portugal. If this was not you, sign that session out.",
                severity = MonarchSecurityAlertSeverity.High,
                dateMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - 1 * 3_600_000L,
                actionLabel = "Review sessions",
            ),
            MonarchSecurityAlert(
                id = "a-2",
                title = "Two-step verification turned on",
                severity = MonarchSecurityAlertSeverity.Info,
                dateMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - 26 * 3_600_000L,
            ),
            MonarchSecurityAlert(
                id = "a-3",
                title = "Password changed",
                severity = MonarchSecurityAlertSeverity.Medium,
                dateMillis = System.currentTimeMillis() - 144 * 3_600_000L,
                read = true,
            ),
        ),
    )
}
